title: Localized Onboarding, Adaptive Performance & Desktop Reliability
headline: SwitchControl 1.3.2 brings a localized first-run experience, faster demand-loaded startup, adaptive performance profiles, honest telemetry, and stronger desktop reliability.
changes: Added a localized first-run and onboarding flow so new users can choose their language before the welcome, disclaimer, and product education surfaces begin
Made Electron startup faster and demand-loaded by moving deep hardware enrichment off the critical path while preserving accurate system context
Introduced adaptive application and machine performance profiles that tune work to available capability without conflating them with display preferences
Improved responsiveness and process telemetry honesty by labeling real system signals accurately and avoiding unsupported input-latency claims or guessed process counts
Hardened desktop reliability across entitlement refresh, startup handoffs, native verification, cleanup cancellation, GPU detection, and other Windows flows
